Nested blockquote produces double-prefixed lines

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<blockquote><p>Outer quote.</p><blockquote><p>Inner quote.</p></blockquote></blockquote>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
}
```
